technique_name: Explain what it means to be a mindful listener
description: Being a mindful listener means being in a state of full presence and attention when you are engaging in a conversation. It involves really listening to the speaker, listening with your heart and soul and being open-minded to their viewpoint. It means actively using nonverbal empathy to acknowledge their feelings and thoughts. As a mindful listener, you are also willing to ask questions to gain clarification and deepen your understanding, show genuine respect for the other person and their ideas,
